## 🎨 Design

## 🐛 Fixed

- **The banner shows up in the log again.** The image shipped `print-banner.sh` without its execute bit, so every start logged `print-banner.sh: Permission denied` where the banner belonged. Matrix itself was not affected. The smoke test now checks for the banner.
